name: PT Apollo Global Interactive Tbk
summary: PT Apollo Global Interactive Tbk, together with its subsidiaries, operates as an integrated automotive company in Indonesia. It operates through three segments: the sale of vehicles and spare parts, operating leases, and others. The company engages in car dealership; sales of spare parts; buying and selling used cars; provision of auto services, as well as auto rental. It is also involved in the fields of trade, services, industry and land transportation. The company was formerly known as PT Bintang Oto Global Tbk and changed its name to PT Apollo Global Interactive Tbk in January 2026. The company was incorporated in 2011 and is based in Malang, Indonesia.
